title: Hear My Prayer (Psalm 61 & 40)
lyrics_original: Hear my cry, O God;
Attend unto my prayer.
From the ends of the earth will I cry unto Thee,
When my heart is overwhelmed;
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
For Thou hast been a shelter for me,
And a strong tower from the enemy.
I will abide in Thy tabernacle forever;
I will trust in the covert of Thy wings.
Psalm 40
I waited patiently for the Lord;
He inclined to me and heard my cry.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit,
Out of the miry clay,
And set my feet upon a rock,
And established my goings.
And He hath put a new song in my mouth,
Even praise unto our God:
Many shall see it, and fear,
And shall trust in the Lord.

bible_verses.english: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer. From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and established my goings.
With my voice, I cry to Yahweh. With my voice, I plead for mercy to Yahweh. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my trouble.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, hear my cry today, for my heart feels overwhelmed and weary. When I cannot find my way, lead me to Jesus, the rock that is higher than I am. Thank You for being my constant shelter and faithful refuge throughout every season of my life. I place my trust in You once again, knowing You hear every whisper of my soul. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings moments where our hearts feel completely overwhelmed, leaving us searching for solid ground. In those desperate hours, this song gently reminds us that God is never out of reach, no matter how distant we may feel. Christ is our higher rock—a steadfast refuge when our own strength gives way. As you sing, bring your weary heart to Him, trusting that the One who has always been your shelter will hold you secure today.
